items.title: Ellis Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I spent four years on that panel... I was on the panel when Antoinette first introduced the idea of giving a jazz award to jazz masters. I was on there to vote for the first one.

ctx.x: Yeah. Antoinette Handy-Miller. I spent four years on that panel. I wasn’t supposed to do that, because I think it was a three-year thing, max.
I wonder if she was – I think she might have studied with Geneva Southall. Is that right? Or did she study with Eileen Southern? But that’s okay. I’ll check that.
